title: glyph_moment params (r05 The Glyph of the Moment)

lattice.description: Glyph strokes run between the points of an n x n lattice.

arc_chance.description: Chance a move is an arc rather than a straight line.

min_nodes.description: Too simple below this many distinct lattice points.

min_moves.description: Too simple below this many moves (after symmetry).

size.description: Glyph side as a fraction of the screen's short side.

look_at.description: Seconds until the 'look' line fades in.

glyph_at.description: Seconds until the glyph cuts in.

show_s.description: Exactly how long the glyph is shown whole.

dissolve_s.description: Seconds the glyph takes to break into static.

static_s.description: Seconds of full static after it is gone.
